---
title: "Phase Plane Explorer"
subtitle: "An interactive replacement for pplane"
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

Type any autonomous system $x' = f(x,y),\ y' = g(x,y)$, or pick an example, then **click in the plane** to start a trajectory. Nullclines, equilibria, and their linearization-based classification update as you change the system or the parameters $a,b,c,d$. For a linear system $\mathbf{x}' = A\mathbf{x}$ the matrix is $A = \begin{pmatrix} a & b\\ c & d\end{pmatrix}$.

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
```{=html}
<iframe class="phaseplane" src="apps/phaseplane.html"
        width="100%" height="1100" style="border:0" loading="lazy"
        title="Phase plane explorer"></iframe>
<script>
window.addEventListener('message', e => {
  if (e.data && e.data.type === 'phaseplane-height')
    document.querySelectorAll('iframe.phaseplane').forEach(f => {
      if (f.contentWindow === e.source) f.style.height = e.data.height + 'px';
    });
});
</script>
```
:::
